comments.author: @stacynhenderson
comments.text:
I've been using Firebase Studio non stop for 3 days. My tips so far:
1. Although the prompt box implies a brief prompt, this is misleading. I have used Gemini for large and detailed descriptions and it does well with this.
2. It will ALWAYS add a green of some sort to every project. Just ask it to remove green before generating. Don't do it in the next step. Specify with 'Color Constraint:' in the prompt if you want to use specific colours.
3. I drop the same massive prompt again and again and get better results every time. I delete the old project and just start over. Iterating isnt worth the time and effort.
4. If it fails to generate API key. Start over. 
5. Wait. Some errors get fixed. Go make a coffee.

Def in beta but wow I think its great. Especially if you are prepared to try 7 times from scratch to get what you want!
